# SAMPLE finance dataset (temporary — generated by scripts/generate-finance-data.ts)

Kept in its own folder on purpose: the academic server loads every CSV of its data dir, so money data must not live there.
All data is fake. Re-run `npm run data:finance` after teachers.csv / sections.csv / conduct.csv change.

| File | Rows | Columns |
| --- | --- | --- |
| tuition.csv | 120 (+5 injected) | student_id, semester, credits_registered, fee_per_credit, discount_pct, amount_due, amount_paid, due_date, paid_date |
| scholarships.csv | 3 | scholarship_id, name, type, amount, min_gpa, min_conduct, slots_per_faculty |
| scholarship_awards.csv | 24 | student_id, semester, scholarship_id, amount |
| payroll.csv | 300 (+2 injected) | teacher_id, month, base_salary, bonus, deductions |

- tuition: one row per student and semester that has grades; credits = sum of the credits of that semester's grade rows (retakes included). The latest semester (2025-1) has more unpaid rows.
- awards: history of every semester except 2025-1, picked with the same rules as the tools (GPA, tuition paid, no owed courses, conduct).
- payroll: one row per teacher and month of every semester in sections.csv; deductions are a fake 10.5 % of base_salary.

## Injected invalid rows (the server must skip and report them)

| File | Line | Problem |
| --- | --- | --- |
| tuition.csv | 122 | duplicate of line 2 |
| tuition.csv | 123 | amount_due 1234567 does not match credits x fee x discount |
| tuition.csv | 124 | discount_pct 150 (> 100) |
| tuition.csv | 125 | amount_paid exceeds amount_due |
| tuition.csv | 126 | due_date 15/10/2024 is not YYYY-MM-DD |
| payroll.csv | 302 | month 2025-13 is not a month |
| payroll.csv | 303 | negative base_salary |
